pairs.target: dé mǎ bǎ tú àn zài dèng miànshàng , zhǐzhe shàngtóu yíkuài xiǎo fāngkuàng . nà shì shài shū péng , mén yīnggāi cháozhe tāmen gāng lái de cháng jiē . kě zhǐ shàng de mén kāi zài lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: Dema pressed the map onto the stool and pointed at a little square. That was the book-drying shed; its door ought to face the long steps they had just climbed. But the door on the paper opened the other way.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛把图按在凳面上，指着上头一块小方框。那是晒书棚，门应该朝着他们刚来的长阶。可纸上的门开在另一边。

pairs.target: chī lí de xuéshēng fǔshēn kàn le yìyǎn , shuō tú shì zhàn zài píng wài huà de , bùnéng ná láiwǎng liǎnshàng tiē . dé mǎ dùnshí táitóu .
pairs.english: The student eating the pear bent to look and said the map had been drawn from outside the terrace, not to be held up against your face. Dema looked up at once.
pairs.hanzi: 吃梨的学生俯身看了一眼，说图是站在坪外画的，不能拿来往脸上贴。德玛顿时抬头。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ fā de shíhòu shuō yìshēng a . " " wǒ shuō le . nǐmen wèn wǒ lí tián bu tián . "
pairs.english: “Then say so when you hand it out!” “I did. You were asking if my pear was sweet.”
pairs.hanzi:
“那你发的时候说一声啊。”
“我说了。你们问我梨甜不甜。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù kàn mǐlā . tā chéngrèn nà shì zìjǐ wèn de , dàn lí bù tián , tú yě bùhǎo rèn , liǎngjiànshì dōu shì zhēnde .
pairs.english: Tavi couldn't help looking at Mira. She admitted she had asked, but the pear wasn't sweet and the map wasn't clear either; both things were true.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住看米拉。她承认那是自己问的，但梨不甜，图也不好认，两件事都是真的。

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ péng , cháng jiē hé bèihòu de liǎngkēshù chóngxīn duì shàng , yán yòubiān de píng lù pǎo qù .
pairs.english: They matched up the shed, the long steps and the two trees behind them again, then ran along the level path to the right.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把棚、长阶和背后的两棵树重新对上，沿右边的平路跑去。

pairs.target: lùshang dēngyǐng yìquānquān cóng jiǎoxià lüèguò , huò dài lún dào dé mǎ bèi . tā xián zhuǎnjiāo làngfèishíjiān , jiānchí lián pǎo liǎngduàn , dào le xǐyīfáng ménwài , chuǎn dé lián bào duìmíng dōu zhǐnéng bào yígè zì .
pairs.english: Circles of lamplight swept beneath their feet as Dema took her turn with the sack. Thinking handovers wasted time, she insisted on running two stretches straight; outside the laundry, she was so breathless she could only give one word of their team name.
pairs.hanzi: 路上灯影一圈圈从脚下掠过，货袋轮到德玛背。她嫌转交浪费时间，坚持连跑两段，到了洗衣房门外，喘得连报队名都只能报一个字。

pairs.target: shuǐ tái biān yǐjīng jǐ zhe sānduì rén . gàizhāng de nǚhái bú zài táiqián , què zhàn zài cèmiàn yíshàn dī chuāng lǐ , gé zhe chuāngtái cuī tāmen páiduì .
pairs.english: Three teams were already crowded by the water stand. The girl giving stamps wasn't in front of it, but in a low window to the side, urging them across the sill to form a queue.
pairs.hanzi: 水台边已经挤着三队人。盖章的女孩不在台前，却站在侧面一扇低窗里，隔着窗台催他们排队。

pairs.target: yuánlái tái biān de dēng bèi fēng chuīmiè le , tā yí dēng qù bìfēng , duìwu gēnzhe dǔ dào le lìng yíshàn chuāngqián .
pairs.english: The lantern beside the stand had blown out; she had moved it out of the wind, and the teams had followed, clogging up the space before another window.
pairs.hanzi: 原来台边的灯被风吹灭了，她移灯去避风，队伍跟着堵到了另一扇窗前。

pairs.target: wén qí zhèng hé tā zhēng , shuō tú shàng míngmíng huà de shì shuǐ tái , búshì chúfáng chuāng . nǚhái shuō zhāng zài zìjǐ shǒulǐ , rén néng guòlái jiù xíng .
pairs.english: Wenqi was arguing with her: the map clearly showed the water stand, not a kitchen window. The girl said she had the stamp; all they had to do was come over.
pairs.hanzi: 闻祁正和她争，说图上明明画的是水台，不是厨房窗。女孩说章在自己手里，人能过来就行。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhuài zhù tǎ wéi de xiùzǐ , búràng tā cóng jīshuǐ biān jǐguòqù . " nà kuài dì quán shì zào shuǐ , huò sǎ le nǐ zìjǐ jiǎn . "
pairs.english: Mira caught Tavi's sleeve, stopping him squeezing past beside the puddle. “That ground is covered in soapy water. Spill the cargo and you pick it up yourself.”
pairs.hanzi:
米拉拽住塔维的袖子，不让他从积水边挤过去。
“那块地全是皂水，货洒了你自己捡。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō rào dào duì wěi yòu yào duō děng yìlún . tā sōngkāi shǒu , liǎn yě chénxiàlái . " nǐ xiǎng yíng , jiù zhǐyǒu nǐ xiǎng yíng ? "
pairs.english: Tavi said going round to the back meant another round of waiting. She let go, her face darkening. “You want to win. Are you the only one?”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维说绕到队尾又要多等一轮。她松开手，脸也沉下来。
“你想赢，就只有你想赢？”

pairs.target: dé mǎ bèizhe bùdài zhàn dào liǎng rén zhōngjiān . " xiān biéchǎo . wǒ yě xiǎng . kěshì néng bunéng xiān xièhuò ? "
pairs.english: Dema stood between them with the sack on her back. “Don't argue yet. I do too. But can we unload first?”
pairs.hanzi: 德玛背着布袋站到两人中间。“先别吵。我也想。可是能不能先卸货？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiē zhù dàizǐ , cái fāxiàn tā bèishàng de yīfu yǐjīng bèi hàn jìntòu . tāmen tuì dào gān dìshàng páiduì , réng bǐ zuìhòu yíduì zǎo dào .
pairs.english: Taking the sack, Tavi only then noticed the clothes on her back were soaked in sweat. They stepped back onto dry ground to queue, still ahead of the last team.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接住袋子，才发现她背上的衣服已经被汗浸透。他们退到干地上排队，仍比最后一队早到。

pairs.target: gāngcái zài shuǐ tái zhēngzhí de wén qí hūrán cóng chuāng biān huílái , zhǐ le zhǐ dī chuāng xiàmiàn de liǎngjí zhǎi jiē , shuō tídài de rén xiān bié shàng , yìzhī shǒufú wěn le zài dì .
pairs.english: Wenqi, who had been arguing by the water stand, suddenly came back from the window. Pointing to the two narrow steps below it, he told whoever carried the sack to wait: get one hand steady before passing it up.
pairs.hanzi: 刚才在水台争执的闻祁忽然从窗边回来，指了指低窗下面的两级窄阶，说提袋的人先别上，一只手扶稳了再递。

pairs.target: mǐlā yìng le yìshēng . tǎ wéi xiǎng jiěshì gāngcái búshì yào bǎ tā diūxià , huàdàozuǐbiān , nǚhái yǐjīng hǎn dào le tāmen . tā zhīdé xiān bǎ dàizǐ bào guòqù .
pairs.english: Mira acknowledged him. Tavi wanted to explain he hadn't meant to leave her behind, but as the words reached his lips the girl called their turn. He had to carry the sack over first.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉应了一声。塔维想解释刚才不是要把她丢下，话到嘴边，女孩已经喊到了他们。他只得先把袋子抱过去。

pairs.target: dìsānzhàn zài zhōnglóu xià de huāpǔ páng , tú shàng huà zhe yìtiáo wānqū de xiǎojìng .
pairs.english: The third stop was beside the flower beds below the bell tower; the map showed a winding path.
pairs.hanzi: 第三站在钟楼下的花圃旁，图上画着一条弯曲的小径。

pairs.target: sān rén chū le xǐyīfáng cái fāxiàn , tèlún nà duì wù jìn le pángbiān de càipǔ tōngdào , jìntóu shì yíshàn suǒ zhe de yuán mén .
pairs.english: Only after leaving the laundry did the three discover that Teren's team had mistakenly entered the vegetable garden passage beside it, ending at a locked garden gate.
pairs.hanzi: 三人出了洗衣房才发现，特伦那队误进了旁边的菜圃通道，尽头是一扇锁着的园门。

pairs.target: nàtiáo lùkǒu de bái dēng shǔyú zhíshǒu diǎn , bìng bù biǎoshì jìntóu néng tōng ; wén qí zhèng jǔ zhe tú , hé dēng xià de gāo nián xuéshēng bǐhuà .
pairs.english: The white lantern at that junction marked a duty post, not a way through; Wenqi was holding up the map and gesturing to the senior student beneath the lantern.
pairs.hanzi: 那条路口的白灯属于值守点，并不表示尽头能通；闻祁正举着图，和灯下的高年学生比画。

pairs.target: dé mǎ kànjiàn le , jiǎobù mànxiàlái . tǎ wéi zhīdào tā zài yóuyù , biàn cháo nàbiān hǎn , shuō qù zhōnglóu dé cóng wàimiàn de pōdào rào , ménnèi méiyǒu jiéjìng .
pairs.english: Dema saw them and slowed. Tavi knew she was hesitating, so called across that the bell tower required a detour along the outer slope; there was no shortcut through the gate.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛看见了，脚步慢下来。塔维知道她在犹豫，便朝那边喊，说去钟楼得从外面的坡道绕，门内没有捷径。

pairs.target: nà duì diàotóu chūlái shí , yǐjīng luòdào le tāmen hòumiàn . dé mǎ huítóu kàn le yìyǎn , méi shuō shénme , bǎ dài shéng jiāogěi tǎ wéi , zìjǐ pǎo dào qiántou tàn nàtiáo wānlù .
pairs.english: When the team turned back out, they were behind them. Dema glanced back without a word, handed Tavi the sack ropes, and ran ahead to scout the winding path.
pairs.hanzi: 那队掉头出来时，已经落到了他们后面。德玛回头看了一眼，没说什么，把袋绳交给塔维，自己跑到前头探那条弯路。

pairs.target: zhōnglóu xiàmiàn yǒu yìxiǎopiàn kòngdì , wǎng wài kàn , zhěngzuò chéng de dēnghuǒ yán shānshì pūkāi , dī chù dùkǒu de yíliè dēng zhèngzài huǎnhuǎn yídòng .
pairs.english: There was a little clearing below the bell tower. Looking out, the city's lights spread along the mountainside, while a row of lights at the landing below was slowly moving.
pairs.hanzi: 钟楼下面有一小片空地，往外看，整座城的灯火沿山势铺开，低处渡口的一列灯正在缓缓移动。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi pǎoshànglái , chàdiǎn wàngjì bǎ dàizǐ dìgěi zhíshǒu de rén . nà búshì yìtiáojiē de dēng , érshì chuán lí le àn , tuō zhe dǎoyǐng cóng hēishuǐ shàng zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi ran up and almost forgot to pass the sack to the person on duty. Those weren't lights on a street: a boat had left the bank, trailing reflections over the black water.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跑上来，差点忘记把袋子递给值守的人。那不是一条街的灯，而是船离了岸，拖着倒影从黑水上走。

pairs.target: mǐlā yě wàng le piànkè , suíhòu shēnshǒu , bǎ tā jiānshàng niǔguòlái de shéngzi fān zhèng . " nǐ gāngcái yào zǒu , zhìshǎo hǎn wǒ . " " wǒ méi xiǎng zìjǐ zǒu . " " wǒ bù zhīdào . "
pairs.english: Mira looked for a moment too, then reached out to straighten the twisted rope on his shoulder. “If you're going, at least call me.” “I didn't mean to go alone.” “I didn't know that.”
pairs.hanzi:
米拉也望了片刻，随后伸手，把他肩上扭过来的绳子翻正。
“你刚才要走，至少喊我。”
“我没想自己走。”
“我不知道。”

pairs.target: tā diǎndiǎntóu . dé mǎ ná zhe gài hǎo de zhǐ qiān huílái , jiàn liǎng rén hái kànzhe chéng , qì dé bǎ zhǐ wǎng tāmen yǎnqián yìhuǎng . " hǎokàn ma ? yíng le zài lái , hǎobuhǎo ? "
pairs.english: He nodded. Dema returned with the stamped slip and, seeing them still looking at the city, irritably waved it before their eyes. “Nice view? Can we win first and come back?”
pairs.hanzi:
他点点头。德玛拿着盖好的纸签回来，见两人还看着城，气得把纸往他们眼前一晃。
“好看吗？赢了再来，好不好？”

pairs.target: zuìhòu yíduànlù méiyǒu zài fēnkāi . tāmen huídào qǐdiǎn shí pái dìsì , mùkuài yikuài bùshǎo . dé mǎ zuòzài dìshàng , jùjué chéngrèn zìjǐ lèi , zhī shuō shì xié bùxíng . pà wò duān lái yìwǎn miàn , shuō dìsì yě yǒujiǎng .
pairs.english: They stayed together on the final stretch. They finished fourth, without losing a single block. Dema sat on the ground, refusing to admit she was tired, saying only her shoes were no good. Pavo brought a bowl of noodles, saying fourth place got a prize too.
pairs.hanzi: 最后一段路没有再分开。他们回到起点时排第四，木块一块不少。德玛坐在地上，拒绝承认自己累，只说是鞋不行。帕沃端来一碗面，说第四也有奖。

pairs.target: miàn yǐjīng tuó le . tāmen zhǎo lái sānshuāng kuàizi , bǎ nà yìtuán fēnkāi . yīwén máng zhe héduì zuìhòu jǐduì , chōukōng wèn bǐsài zěnmeyàng .
pairs.english: The noodles had clumped. They found three pairs of chopsticks and divided the lump. Busy checking the final teams, Iven found a moment to ask how the race had been.
pairs.hanzi: 面已经坨了。他们找来三双筷子，把那一团分开。伊文忙着核对最后几队，抽空问比赛怎么样。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō tú kěyǐ zhònghuà . dé mǎ shuō jiǎng kěyǐ huàn . tǎ wéi zuǐlǐsāi zhe miàn , téng chūshǒu lái , tì tā ànzhù yòu kuài bèi fēngchuī zǒu de míngdān .
pairs.english: Mira said the maps could be redrawn. Dema said the prizes could be changed. With his mouth full of noodles, Tavi freed a hand to hold down Iven's roster, just as the wind nearly carried it away again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说图可以重画。德玛说奖可以换。塔维嘴里塞着面，腾出手来，替他按住又快被风吹走的名单。
